verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state you can 'Pick the skills and agents you use' and 'Install the ones you want, then type a slash command,' directly supporting selective installation rather than an all-or-nothing bundle, and the installer writes editable per-skill files into the project so they can be added/removed individually. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a third party that partial installs actually work as described, since community evidence discusses skill quality/utility but not the install granularity itself.
